name: Unverified_03f9
fix_description: In uniswapV3SwapCallback (0xfa461e33), no validation that msg.sender is a legitimate Uniswap V3 pool. Anyone can call the callback to trigger token transfers from the contract. Fix: compute expected pool address from CREATE2 and verify msg.sender matches.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short but protocol-specific multi-step attack: flash-loan BUSD, swap into the target token, abuse repeated pair.skim calls by manipulating token balances/reserves, then swap back and repay. It requires understanding Uniswap V2 pair reserve/balance mechanics and why skim can be abused here, so it is not a purely obvious single-step bug.
